item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get clean
# Apply GTK/legacy window theme.
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme 'Orchis'
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences theme 'Orchis'
# Prefer dark controls if this GNOME schema supports it.
if gsettings writable org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme 'prefer-light'
fi
# Make GTK4/libadwaita apps pick up the Orchis CSS where possible.
mkdir -p /home/user/.config/gtk-4.0
cp -a /home/user/.themes/Orchis/gtk-4.0/. /home/user/.config/gtk-4.0/
# Enable and set User Themes extension if GNOME sees it.
if gnome-extensions list | rg -qx 'user-theme@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampax.github.com'; then
  gnome-extensions enable user-theme@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampax.github.com || true
  gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name 'Orchis'
fi
printf 'gtk-theme='; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme
printf 'wm-theme='; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences theme
if gsettings list-schemas | rg -qx 'org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme'; then printf 'shell-theme='; gsettings get org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name; fi
printf 'enabled-extensions='; gsettings get org.gnome.shell enabled-extensions
"
